title: Brex product cards
description: A centred headline with a grey subtitle over a row of five pale-grey cards (stacked on phones). Each card has a 24px title, a short grey line and an illustration cropped by its bottom edge; hovering lifts a soft shadow.
notes: media slots: one product illustration per card, cropped by the card's bottom edge
cards are 324px tall and the illustration fills what is left under the text
